subject: quartz-manager-standalone
purpose: Third application excluded from method development; one positive-control workflow only.
workflow: create stored durable job; change description; fresh native UI and API read

deployment_attempts.reason: Executable jar omits its declared optional Springdoc dependencies; class io.swagger.v3.oas.models.OpenAPI unavailable. No workflow requests.
Disabling quartz-manager.oas.enabled does not disable unconditional showcase OpenAPI bean signatures. No workflow requests.
Pacific host clock interpreted as Europe/Rome by native JWT helper; newly issued token expired. No job workflow requests.

Native UI loaded and credentials filled; pending response wait rejected during cleanup after an earlier UI interaction error. Exact primary exception was not saved. Screenshot/log retained; no job writes in server log.
Official matching UI and declared runtime dependencies on external classpath; JVM Europe/Rome timezone; form-scoped login locator and robust capture cleanup.
